content:
Shares of GE Vernova (GEV) returned 66.5% in the twelve months to October 13, 2026, outpacing the 20.5% return for the S&P 500. During that period, orders consistently increased at the company’s Power and Electrification businesses, and management raised its 2026 revenue forecast twice. Those orders appear to be what investors were paying for. So what could you have seen of those orders before the twelve months began, on October 10, 2025?

Investors could have seen the orders directly in management’s commentary almost a year prior to October 10, 2025. During the October 23, 2024 call for the third quarter of 2024, management noted that Power orders rose 34% in the quarter. Orders represent sales that customers commit to before they appear in revenue. Rising orders provided an early sign of sales to come.

Three months later, on the January 22, 2025 call for the fourth quarter of 2024, management reported that it had grown its backlog. Backlog measures the orders GE Vernova had taken but not yet delivered.

Quarterly Results Quickened At GE Vernova

Revenue growth accelerated during the first half of 2025, according to reports filed before October 10, 2025. After rising 5.1% from a year earlier in the fourth quarter of 2024, revenue grew 10.6% in the first quarter of 2025. On April 23, 2025, Reuters reported that first-quarter revenue beat estimates on strong performance at the Power and Electrification units. Growth reached 11.1% in the second quarter of 2025, in results filed on July 23, 2025.

The stock was moving higher well before the twelve months analyzed here. Shares rose 88.3% in the six months before October 10, 2025. A reader who acted on the orders in late 2024 or early 2025 would have caught that advance as well.

Over the same twelve months, Eaton returned 17.3% and Honeywell International 10.5%. Neither of these two peers shared the run.

By fiscal 2025, Electrification had become a much bigger business . Revenue for the segment rose 27.7% that year to $9.6 billion, accounting for 25% of GE Vernova’s revenue for the year. Wind went the other direction. Its revenue fell 6.1% to $9.1 billion, dropping below Electrification’s.

Are GE Vernova’s Orders Still Growing?

They are, according to figures from the July 22, 2026 call for the second quarter of 2026. Power orders more than doubled, and Electrification orders rose 66% from a year earlier. Management now expects 2026 revenue of $45.5 billion to $46.5 billion, compared with $38.1 billion in fiscal 2025.

Wind remains the weak point. Its orders fell 40% in the second quarter of 2026, and management noted that it is hard to call a turn in U.S. orders. Yet even as Power and Electrification orders grew, the shares have stalled, returning 1.7% over the past six months against 12.6% for the S&P 500.

If GE Vernova’s third-quarter 2026 report shows Power and Electrification orders still up from a year earlier, the growth seen before the run is still going. If they fall, that growth may have run its course.

chineseTitle: GE Vernova 股票还在告诉你同样的事情吗？
chineseSummary: 截至 2026 年 10 月 13 日的 12 个月内，GE Vernova (GEV) 的股价回报率为 66.5%，超过标准普尔 500 指数 20.5% 的回报率。在此期间，该公司电力和电气化业务的订单持续增加，管理层两次上调了 2026 年收入预测。这些订单似乎正是投资者所付出的代价。那么，在 2025 年 10 月 10 日这 12 个月开始之前，您会看到这些订单的情况如何。
chineseContent:
截至 2026 年 10 月 13 日的 12 个月内，GE Vernova (GEV) 的股价回报率为 66.5%，超过标准普尔 500 指数 20.5% 的回报率。在此期间，该公司电力和电气化业务的订单持续增加，管理层两次上调了 2026 年收入预测。这些订单似乎正是投资者所付出的代价。那么，在 2025 年 10 月 10 日这 12 个月开始之前，您能看到这些订单吗？

投资者几乎可以在 2025 年 10 月 10 日之前的一年前直接在管理层的评论中看到这些订单。在 2024 年 10 月 23 日的 2024 年第三季度电话会议中，管理层指出，该季度的电力订单增长了 34%。订单代表客户在出现收入之前承诺的销售额。订单的增加是销售即将到来的早期迹象。

三个月后，在 2025 年 1 月 22 日召开的 2024 年第四季度会议上，管理层报告称积压订单有所增加。积压订单衡量 GE Vernova 已接受但尚未交付的订单。

像这样运行测试每个退休计划。如果您的顾问最近退休，那么现在是向我们的合作伙伴公司免费提供第二意见的好时机。

GE Vernova 季度业绩加速增长

根据 2025 年 10 月 10 日之前提交的报告，2025 年上半年收入增长加速。2024 年第四季度收入同比增长 5.1%，2025 年第一季度收入增长 10.6%。2025 年 4 月 23 日，路透社报道称，第一季度收入超出了电力和电气部门强劲业绩的预期。根据 2025 年 7 月 23 日提交的业绩，2025 年第二季度增长率达到 11.1%。

早在此处分析的十二个月之前，该股就已经走高。 2025 年 10 月 10 日之前的六个月里，股价上涨了 88.3%。在 2024 年末或 2025 年初执行订单的读者也会注意到这一涨幅。

在这 12 个月里，伊顿公司的回报率为 17.3%，霍尼韦尔国际公司的回报率为 10.5%。这两个同伴都没有分享跑步。

到 2025 财年，电气化已成为一项规模更大的业务。该部门当年收入增长 27.7%，达到 96 亿美元，占 GE Vernova 当年收入的 25%。风向另一个方向吹去。其收入下降 6.1% 至 91 亿美元，低于电气化收入。

GE Vernova 的订单还在增长吗？

根据 2026 年 7 月 22 日公布的 2026 年第二季度数据显示，电力订单增长了一倍多，电气化订单同比增长 66%。管理层目前预计 2026 年营收为 455 亿至 465 亿美元，而 2025 财年为 381 亿美元。

风仍然是弱点。其2026年第二季度的订单下降了40%，管理层指出，很难说美国订单出现好转。然而，尽管电力和电气化订单增长，该股却停滞不前，过去六个月的回报率为 1.7%，而标准普尔 500 指数的回报率为 12.6%。

如果 GE Vernova 的 2026 年第三季度报告显示电力和电气化订单仍较上年同期增长，那么运行前的增长仍在继续。如果它们下跌，那么增长可能就到头了。

您的顾问退休了吗？和解之前征求第二意见
